## Description

Models institutional order execution as a Stackelberg game where reinforcement learning execution agents act as leaders optimizing execution schedules against reactive market impact follower populations.

## Where it may fit

Large institutional block trades, illiquid asset liquidation, minimizing adverse market impact.

## Vehicles

Agency Execution Desks, Algorithmic Execution Brokers, Institutional Asset Managers.

## Required data

Order book depth profiles, historical volume participation curves, temporary/permanent impact coefficients.

## Caveats

Stackelberg leader-follower RL training requires nested simulation environments to prevent policy divergence.
